title: gpt-image-2
prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram
Primary request: A premium educational poster/infographic about the rise and fall of the Tang Dynasty (618-907 AD) in Chinese history. Vertical poster layout. Top: bold title '唐朝兴衰史' (The Rise and Fall of Tang Dynasty) in Chinese calligraphy. Four horizontal phases as a timeline flowing top-to-bottom, each phase in a colored band with elegant Tang-dynasty-style border patterns: 1 初唐 (Founding & Zhenguan Era, 618-712, founding prosperity) in warm gold and cinnabar red; 2 盛唐 (High Tang / Kaiyuan Golden Age, 712-755, peak of silk road, poetry, art, Wu Zetian, Xuanzong, Yang Guifei) in lush emerald green and imperial gold; 3 中唐 (Mid Tang, An Lushan Rebellion aftermath, 755-820, decline, poets Du Fu, Bai Juyi) in muted bronze and faded amber; 4 晚唐 (Late Tang, 820-907, fragmentation, Five Dynasties transition, Huang Chao Rebellion, fall in 907) in desaturated ink gray and cold iron blue. Each band has a small Chinese label, key figures or events listed, and a decorative Tang-era motif (peony, camel on silk road, broken sword, falling leaf). Bottom: a small closing line '907年亡' in seal script. Traditional Chinese aesthetic, Tang dynasty art influence, rich mineral pigments on aged rice-paper texture, elegant gold leaf accents, museum-quality poster design. All Chinese text must be clearly readable and correctly rendered.
Style/medium: premium educational poster, traditional Tang dynasty aesthetic, Chinese art influence
Composition/framing: vertical poster, top title, 4 horizontal timeline bands top-to-bottom, decorative borders
Lighting/mood: even museum-quality lighting, rich pigment saturation
Color palette: Tang dynasty mineral pigments, aged rice paper, gold leaf, cinnabar, emerald, bronze, ink gray
Text (verbatim): "唐朝兴衰史, 初唐, 盛唐, 中唐, 晚唐, 907年亡"
Constraints: vertical poster format, Chinese text clearly readable, 4 phases top-to-bottom timeline, traditional Tang aesthetic
Avoid: photorealism, neon colors, modern UI elements, 3D render, watermark
